name: brandlyframes
description: BrandlyFrames core — programmatic video SDK for React: a video is a pure function of the frame number (frame -> pixels).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --jsx=automatic --outfile=dist/index.js --external:react --external:react-dom --external:zod && esbuild src/template-registry.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=dist/template-registry.js
